```{r}
#| fig-cap: High-coverage community districts under contact- vs movement-neutralizing strategies (33 % coverage)
#| label: 'fig-hiimpact-communities-bar'
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 9

targets::tar_read(plotdata_coverage_approach_bar) |>
  plot_coverage_bar() +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc(name = "", na.translate = FALSE, option = "light")  +
  scale_axis_mpxnyc(
    "Proportion of MPX NYC sample",
    limits = c(-0.08, 0.15),
    breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15)
  ) +
  theme_mpxnyc_bar(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(20, 20,20,20))
    )

```
